collection.title: Peugeot 508 Saloon 2011 to 2018 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Peugeot 508 Saloon 2011 - 2018 will fit, this model requires a 26" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
